I'm going to start by giving some background on myself. Hi, my name's Samantha Cordelia, and I'm a non-binary femenine leaning person. Im from the Dominican Republic, and I moved to the US when I was 8 years old. My parents weren't great. My family is very dysfunctional.

My mom was very mentally abusive and put me down a lot. On more than one occasion i was beaten. At 16 I was diagnosed with depression by my therapist, but my mother refused to let me be medicated for it. During the time this abuse was happening, I kept telling my ex (may she rip)

What was happening. Cps was never called. So I clung to my ex because she was the only life line I had. The relationship was less than perfect but she got me through a lot, and she's the reason I made it to 19 years old. I'm grateful for that.

Since I moved away from my mother, and kept contact to a minimum, my mental health has gotten better. Not enough to be off my medicine. I know because I get spotty with taking it, and the depression comes back. but I try my best to stay on track.

The thing that's getting to me though, and it's selfish. Is the fact that the person who I used to anchor to, took her own life recently. My ex was there through all my formative years. Things didn't end well between us. Her mental illness was getting the best of her back then.

That year I quit my job, I quit school, and I distanced myself from friends because my mental health was so awful I wasn't sure if I actually wanted to be alive. I was really truly considering it. And it upset me. It made me angry. I felt alone and neglected and abandoned.

So I left her. It was the hardest thing I had ever done. This girl was my whole world. And for months after she still was. I'd think about her a lot. I didn't think life was worth living without her. looking back now, it was toxic. That year was toxic. We were toxic.

We were like an acid bath corroding metal. We fed into each other's misery and I just couldn't keep doing that to myself. After the breakup I developed an ED. I stopped eating, and would Eat maybe once a day. I lost a lot of weight, extremely fast in a short period of time.

For once in my life I knew what it was like to feel genuinely loved and cared about. She pushed me to do better. I got medicated for my depression. I got a new job. That didn't work out because jobs suck though and I was v fragile mentally.
